claims.statement: Management continues to be upbeat on value-added high value product Isostearic Acid
Couple of more full container load export shipments of Isostearic Acid to Europe made during March 2024
Company has got further orders for export of Isostearic Acid for other locations of existing customer as well as new customers
Targets 15% EBITDA margin for FY25 on full-year basis, improving quarter-to-quarter
Expects volume growth of 10-15% in FY25, consistent with historical momentum
EBITDA margin declined to 10.78% in FY24 from higher levels historically due to Isostearic Acid stabilization losses
Isostearic Acid stabilization caused material losses and high utility costs, impacting EBITDA margins in FY24
Stabilization losses for Isostearic Acid are now over; margins to improve quarter-to-quarter in FY25
Isostearic Acid plant expected to reach full stabilization and 100% capacity utilization by September 2024
40,000 MT capacity earmarked for new raw material project out of total 120,000 MT; R&D complete, pilot plant work started
Forward integration capex for Isostearic Acid to be funded from internal accruals, not substantial, no long-term loans
No capacity expansion capex planned for old products in FY25; focus on product upgrades and forward integration
Isostearic Acid orders exceed current production capacity; plant stabilizing to meet demand
Capital expenditure for FY24 was INR 176 million
Installation of additional equipment to boost production of Isostearic Acid
Expansion of Dimerization capacity due to encouraging responses from developed markets
Pilot testing for new Oleo Chemical products from a new raw material
EBITDA margin improved to 13.22% in Q1 FY25 due to Isostearic acid revenue and absence of startup losses
Targeting full Isostearic acid capacity utilization of 500 MT per quarter by end of 2024
Company upbeat on value-added product Isostearic Acid
H1 FY25 capital expenditure INR 148 Mn
Volume growth guidance of 10-15% for FY25 not revised but difficult to achieve due to Q2 shortfall and likely Q3 weakness
EBITDA margin target of 14-15% achievable if government reverses duty hike and paint demand revives
Isostearic acid can lift margins to 12% even if duty hike persists, provided paint demand revives and approvals come through
Linoleic acid and dimer acid together contribute 68-69% of sales value; Isostearic acid to become prime product going forward
Total capacity 120,000 tpa split into 80,000 tpa for current products and 40,000 tpa earmarked for new products; Q2 utilisation ~75% of 80,000 tpa
Capex of Rs 5-10 cr remaining for current activities by March 2025; potential Rs 30-35 cr for solar plant (land purchase included) with 4-4.5 year payback
New product plant capex estimated at Rs 35-40 cr additional in FY26 after successful pilot plant run
Projected Total Revenue for FY25 is INR 7,350 Mn
Projected EBITDA for FY25 is INR 1,200 Mn
Projected EBITDA Margin for FY25 is 16.34%
Raw material throughput capacity is 120,000 MTPA
Expect higher Isostearic Acid export volumes from April 2025
Management says internal FY25 revenue projection of Rs 735 crore and FY26 projection of Rs 979 crore no longer hold good due to duty changes and demand drop
Management expects EBITDA margins to reach 12-15% next year from April 2025 onwards driven by isostearic acid ramp-up even without duty reversal
Q3 FY25 EBITDA margin at 6.87% vs 9.21% for 9M FY25; margins pressured by higher raw material cost from duty hike and lower paint sector demand

New product plant designed with permissions ready; equipment orders pending manufacturing cost/yield confidence; 1.5-2 years to build, another 1.5 years to stabilize; full capacity within 3 years of go-ahead
Export volumes of Isostearic Acid expected to increase gradually from H1 FY26 and further in H2 FY26
FY25 capital expenditure INR 255 Mn
Q4 FY25 EBITDA margin was 3.64% due to higher raw material cost as percentage of sales
FY25 EBITDA margin was 7.96%
Confident of achieving higher capacity utilization by end of FY26
Isostearic acid expected to reach optimum utilization by FY27
New product plant equipment ordered, expected to arrive by December, trials in January-March period
Earmarked 40,000 tons of 120,000 tons installed capacity for new product family
Isostearic Acid export volumes expected to rise in staggered manner over coming quarters
Raw material throughput capacity expanded to 120,000 MTPA in Q1-FY23
Management expects FY26 to remain challenging due to competitive pressures and US duty issues on isostearic acid exports, but remains confident long-term.
Q1 FY26 EBITDA margin improved slightly to 3.97% from 3.64% in previous quarter due to power and fuel cost savings, partially offset by higher raw material costs.
Historical EBITDA margins were 15-17% before government increased vegetable oil import duty from 5.5% to 27.5%; current margins around 4%.
Management says isostearic acid alone cannot lift company-level EBITDA margin from 4% to 20%; any improvement would be gradual.
Current capacity utilization ~70% at INR 131 crore quarterly revenue; installed raw material throughput capacity 120,000 MTPA, with 40,000 MTPA earmarked for new products.
Isostearic acid capacity estimated at 10-15% of total global demand; no exact global demand data available.
Management withdrew previous FY25/FY26 guidance of INR 1,000 crore revenue and 23% EBITDA margin, stating assumptions no longer hold due to tariff and regulatory headwinds.
No new guidance provided for FY27 due to unresolved U.S. tariff, Isostearic Acid regulatory approvals, and animal feed project timeline uncertainties.
Q2 FY26 EBITDA margin at 3.77%, H1 at 3.87%; management expects margins to stay at current low levels until U.S. tariff, China competition, and raw material issues resolve.
Double-digit EBITDA margins possible only if U.S. tariff eases, raw material prices soften, Isostearic Acid exports revive, and animal feed product commercializes.
Isostearic Acid export ramp-up to non-U.S. markets delayed due to regulatory compliance with two major European producers; approvals pending.
Dimer Acid exports to U.S. halted due to 50% tariff; management expects substantial exports to resume if India-U.S. trade deal results in rational tariff of 10-15%.
Another new product (non-animal feed) progressing well; first commercial production trial by March 2026 or April-June 2026 quarter.
Confident to ramp up high margin export sales after US tariff announcement and proposed FTA with UK/EU
Raw material throughput capacity expansion completed with minimal capex
Buy-back of INR 340 Mn completed in Jan-26
Management expects volume and value growth every quarter going forward, with EBITDA margins improving gradually and better numbers from H2 FY27
Management targets export share to rise from 9% to as high as 50% of revenue
Q3 FY26 EBITDA margin was 4.2%; nine-month EBITDA margin was 3.97%
Dimer acid margins remain under pressure from aggressive Chinese pricing and unchanged 7.5% import duty
If China removes export incentives on dimer acid, domestic prices could rise 12-13%, flowing largely to EBITDA
Q3 FY26 volume throughput was 9,850 tonnes; management says capacity can double from current levels
Current capacity utilisation is around 55%; no further capex needed to achieve export target of 50% of turnover
Animal feed plant is ready, awaiting GMP certification; new product equipment expected in production by Q3 FY27
Initial capacity for new product will be small; major expansion after buyer approvals (2-3 years)
FY30E revenue target INR 20,000 Mn
FY30E EBITDA target INR 4,300 Mn
FY30E PAT target INR 3,100 Mn
Aim to increase exports to initially 25% and eventually 50% of sales
Targeting 8% EBITDA margin for FY27
Expect 75-80% capacity utilization in FY27
Export contribution expected to reach 20% in FY27
Long-term revenue target of Rs 2,000 crores by FY30
Phase 1 capex of Rs 20-25 crores for new 40,000 tonne product
No major capex in FY27 except energy savings
Current plant capacity 80,000 tonnes at 65-66% utilization
New product capacity 40,000 tonnes to be added over 5 years
New product plant commissioning by end of Q2 FY27
Bypass fat plant operational next month
Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin improved to 6.8% on better price realization
Realization improved 8-10% due to reduced Chinese dumping
Aim to increase exports initially by 25% and eventually to 50% of sales
Raw materials throughput capacity expansion completed with minimal capex
Target to increase capacity utilization by 10-20 percentage points by end of FY27, aiming for 70-75% exit rate
Expect to maintain current revenue and margin run rate for remaining three quarters of FY27
Plan to grow sales volumes by 5-7% per quarter, targeting 15-20% volume growth by end of FY27
Current capacity utilization at ~60%, targeting 70-75% exit rate for FY27 on 80,000 MT capacity
Isostearic acid capacity utilization expected to reach >80% in next 1-2 years
New 40,000 MT oleochemical capacity to start trial runs in Q2 FY27, margins expected better than current
EBITDA margin improved to 10.14% in Q1 FY27, supported by better domestic realization and easing import pressure
Inverted duty structure (raw material 16.5% vs finished product 7.5%) causes 9% margin loss
Raw materials throughput capacity expansion completed with minimal capex
Aim to increase export share initially by 25% and eventually to 50% of sales
Reduction in import duty on crude soya oil from 16.5% to 11.0% likely to improve raw material availability and capacity utilization
Management expects 5-10% quarterly growth and aims to improve capacity utilization from current 60-65%
Current capacity utilization is 60-65% with expectation to improve 5% per quarter
Management targets 15-18% EBITDA margin long-term, up from current 10.5%
No immediate expansion plans; land purchase of Rs 12 crore was for existing operations; future capex depends on new product success
